Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingOutbu:
Your character may turn to face a zombie. Consists of two phases:
1. Movement Lock: You cannot move or look away.
2. Idle: Your character will turn towards zombie when you stand still for a bit.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinBl: Bloodlust level above which tracking may occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxBl: Bloodlust level at which max tracking chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxCh:
Maximum chance for tracking to occur, tested every in-game minute.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingRequi: How many real seconds since last player activity must pass for tracking to occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinVi: Closest zombie that you can see must be this many tiles away from you for tracking to occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinHi: Closest zombie that you cannot see must be this many tiles away from you for tracking to occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem: When tracking occurs, for how many real seconds you won't be able to control your character as it stands still, looking in direction of closest zombie.
Tracking Movement Lock Min Tiles From Zombie
Minimum tiles to closest zombie for tracking movement lock to happen.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopI: Tracking Stop If Zombie Within Tiles
Once tracking is active, if closest zombie is visible and is closer than this many tiles, don't track it.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinMi: Minimum in-game minutes tracking may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxMi: Maximum in-game minutes tracking may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingOutb:
Your character may walk towards a zombie. Consists of two phases:
1. Active: Any movement input moves you towards closest zombie.
2. Idle: You move towards closest zombie if you're idle.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinB: Bloodlust level above which following may occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxB: Bloodlust level at which max following chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol:
Maximum chance for Tracking to evolve into Following, tested every in-game minute, if player is moving.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Tracking To Following Min Tiles From Visible Zombie
Minimum distance visible zombie must be for Tracking to evolve into Following.
Tracking To Following Min Tiles From Hidden Zombie
Minimum distance zombie you don't see must be for Tracking to evolve into Following.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi: Following Active Min Tiles From Zombie
How many tiles away a closest zombie must be for active following phase.
Minimum real seconds active phase may last for.
Maximum real seconds active phase may last for.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMove: Following Movement Attempt Moves For Seconds
During active phase, pressing a movement key will keep you moving towards closest zombie for this many seconds after the key is released.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingIdle: Following Idle Min Tiles From Zombie
How many tiles away a closest zombie must be for idle following phase.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingAfte: Minimum real seconds you must be inactive for idle following to start.
Maximum real seconds you must be inactive for idle following to start.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking: Start Tracking After Inactivity When Following
Once this percentage of inactivity time passes, the character will turn towards closest zombie.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinI: Minimum in-game minutes following may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxI: Maximum in-game minutes following may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingEndT: Chance to immediately start Tracking when Following ends.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHours_t: How many in-game hours without killing it takes to reach maximum bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHoursEx:
Determines when most of the bloodlust is added.

1 = linear increase, >1 higher increase the more time passes, <1 lower increase the more time passes.

For 36 hours until max bloodlust and exponent 3, first 1%% bloodlust is reached at 7th hour, 50%% at 29th hour and 100%% at 36th hour.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingBloodiness:
How much your bloodiness reduces the time it takes to reach 100%% bloodlust.

0.5 means 50%% less time at 100%% bloodiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingStaleBlood:
How much staleness multiplies kill craving bloodiness factor.

1.0 means 100%% stale bloodiness makes your 50%% bloodiness count as 100%% bloodiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingHealthExpo:
How much low health increases the time it takes to reach 100%% bloodlust.

2.0 means on 50%% health it takes ~3 times longer to reach 100%% bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatAfterM: Spending this much time in combat without hitting anyone will start increasing your bloodlust (If not in frenzy).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl:
How much bloodlust to add every minute you aren't hitting anyone in combat.

With 3, it'll take 33 minutes to reach 100 bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderShovesAndStom: Consider Shoves And Stomps As Hits
Whether shoving and stomping are considered as hits (Used for fightless combat bloodlust increase).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderCarDriveOverA: Consider Car Drive Over As Combat
Whether killing zombies by driving over them is considered as hits (Used for fightless combat bloodlust increase).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl: Whether your bloodlust will increase without fighting while driving.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_GettingBloodyBloodlus:
How much bloodlust to add (positive) or remove (negative) proportional to you getting bloodier.

With 0.25, +100%% bloodiness on any individual body part, clothing or weapon will add 25 bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_GettingBloodyStressCh:
How much stress to add (positive) or remove (negative) proportional to you getting bloodier.

With -0.5, +100%% bloodiness on any individual body part, clothing or weapon will remove 50%% stress.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_GettingBloodyUnhappin:
How much happiness to add (positive) or remove (negative) proportional to you getting bloodier.

With -0.3, +100%% bloodiness on any individual body part, clothing or weapon will remove 30%% happiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustLevelForMood:
Bloodlust after which unhappiness, stress and boredom starts to increase if you aren't fighting.

The increase starts small, and reaches its maximum at 100%% bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MoodDebuffBloodlustEx:
Determines when most of the mood debuffs are applied depending on bloodlust.

1 = linear increase, >1 higher increase the higher the bloodlust, <1 lower increase the higher the bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessImpactOnMoo:
How much your bloodiness reduces the time it takes to reach 100%% unhappiness/stress/boredom.

0.5 means 50%% quicker worst mood if 100%% bloody.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBloodlustDepressio:
At 100%% bloodlust, it will take this in-game hours to reach 100%% unhappiness.

Note: Because boredom is also added, and boredom increases unhappiness, the actual depression time will be lower.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBloodlustFullStres: Max Bloodlust Full Stress After Hours

At 100%% bloodlust, it will take this in-game hours to reach 100%% stress.

Note: Idle stress reduction is negated once mood debuffs kick in, so this is pretty accurate.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBloodlustFullBored: Max Bloodlust Full Boredom After Hours
At 100%% bloodlust, it will take this in-game hours to reach 100%% boredom.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillBloodlustReductio: Every generic kill reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpKillBloodlustRed: Every kill with sharp weapons (spears, axes, blades) reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KnifeKillBloodlustRed: Every kill with knives reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_RangedKillBloodlustRe: Every ranged kill (with firearms) reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_HitBloodlustReduction: Every generic hit reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpHitBloodlustRedu: Every hit with sharp weapons (spears, axes, blades) reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KnifeHitBloodlustRedu: Every hit with knives reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_RangedHitBloodlustRed: Every ranged hit (with firearms) reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_HurtBloodlustChange_t: How much bloodlust to increase/decrease when you get hit by a zombie.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForFrenzy_t:
How bloody overall you must be to start progressing towards frenzy.

You may set this beyond 100%% if you intend to require at least some freshness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessMu:
How much bloodiness freshness makes bloodiness count as more.

0.5 means 100%% freshness counts like +50%% more of bloodiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessFr:
Determines how strongly bloodiness freshness accelerates progress toward frenzy.

At 4, 50%% freshness doubles the rate of frenzy progression, while 100%% freshness quadruples it.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustOverreducedF: You must reduce this much bloodlust (via hits/kills) while having no bloodlust to go into frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyPerMinuteDecayI: Frenzy Per Minute Decay In Combat

How much frenzy bloodlust to reduce in combat.

Note that this applies to progress towards frenzy (the bloodlust you reduced while at 0).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyPerMinuteDecayO: Frenzy Per Minute Decay Out Of Combat

How much frenzy bloodlust to reduce out of combat.

Note that this applies to progress towards frenzy (the bloodlust you reduced while at 0).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyKillBloodlustIn: Every generic kill increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzySharpKillBloodl: Every kill with sharp weapons (spears, axes, blades) increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyKnifeKillBloodl: Every kill with knives increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyRangedKillBlood: Every ranged kill (with firearms) increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHitBloodlustInc: Every generic hit increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzySharpHitBloodlu: Every hit with sharp weapons (spears, axes, blades) increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyKnifeHitBloodlu: Every hit with knives increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyRangedHitBloodl: Every ranged hit (with firearms) increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtBloodlustCh: How much bloodlust to increase/decrease when you get hit by a zombie in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeDestre:
Proportion of bloodlust change from hits/kills to add as stress reduction.

With 5, it'll take 20 bloodlust increased/decreased to go from 100%% stress to absolute chill.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeHappin:
Proportion of bloodlust change from hits/kills to add as unhappiness reduction.

With 2, it'll take 50 bloodlust increased/decreased to go from depression to happiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustAdditionalDa:
How much additional damage to deal at instakill bloodlust level.

The bonus increases smoothly as bloodlust rises, reaching the value you set at the bloodlust level required for instakill.

With bloodlust required for instakill set to 90 and default additional damage of 0.5,
you'll deal 0.5 bonus damage at 90 bloodlust, 0.25 at 45 bloodlust, etc.

Max zombie health is 2.0.

How much additional damage to deal at instakill bloodlust level in frenzy.

The bonus increases smoothly as bloodlust rises, reaching the value you set at the bloodlust level required for instakill.

With bloodlust required for instakill set to 90 and default additional damage of 0.75,
you'll deal 0.75 bonus damage at 90 bloodlust, 0.375 at 45 bloodlust, etc.

Max zombie health is 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWithB: Whether to deal additional damage for hits with bare hands.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWorks: Whether to deal additional damage for hits firearms.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_InstakillAtBloodlust_: Bloodlust level above which your next hit will kill instantly.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_InstakillWorksForRang:
Whether instakilling is possible when shooting zombies.

Finally, your tiny lil' pistolittle can annihilate a zombie out of existence even when it barely touched its pinky.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_InstakillDamage_toolt:
How much damage is dealt on instakill.

You can reduce this to turn instakilling into massive damage dealing instead.

Max zombie health is 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_InstakillBloodlustRed: How much bloodlust is removed when an instakill is triggered.
How much bloodlust is removed when an instakill is triggered in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_InstakillDueToCraving:
How much muscle strain is spread across your whole body when instakill is triggered.

One body part can hold 100 strain.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla:
How much muscle strain will be spread across your whole body for each instakill in frenzy.

One body part can hold 100 strain.

How much fatigue will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 2.5 it'll take ~40 instakills for 100%% fatigue.

How much hunger will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 3.33 it'll take ~30 instakills for 100%% hunger.

How much thirst will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 5 it'll take ~20 instakills for 100%% thirst.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklashPerMinu:
How much of backlash to apply every in-game minute once frenzy ends.

Each instakill in frenzy adds 1.0 to backlash.

With 0.5 it'll take ~3.3 in-game hours to apply backlash for 100 instakills.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaDa:
How much damage to additionally spread evenly to nearby zombies while instakilling in frenzy.

Max zombie health is 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaRa: Maximum tiles from instakilled zombie in which others will be affected.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillZombie: Maximum number of zombies affected by area damage.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_InstakillSoundRadius_:
Zombies this many tiles away will be attracted to player on instakill.

For reference, shout sound radius is 30. See pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_InstakillSoundRadiusI:
Zombies this many tiles away will be attracted to player on instakill in frenzy.

For reference, shout sound radius is 30. See pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_RevengeInstakillSound:
Zombies this many tiles away will be attracted to player on instakill triggered after getting hit.

For reference, shout sound radius is 30. See pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeAtBl: In frenzy, getting hit with this much bloodlust will instakill the attacker and push back other zombies around.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeDama:
How much damage to deal to an attacker when you get hit in frenzy.

Max zombie health is 2.0, so 2 damage will instakill whoever attacked you.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengePush: Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back on hit revenge.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeZomb: Maximum number of zombies pushed back when on hit revenge.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeKnoc: Frenzy Hurt Revenge Knock Down Chance
Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down on hit revenge.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtSoundRadius:
Zombies this many tiles away will be attracted to player in frenzy that just got hit.

For reference, shout sound radius is 30. See pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBloodlustFrenzyWea: Max Bloodlust Frenzy Weapon Speed Increase

How much faster you swing your weapon while in frenzy as you reach 100%% bloodlust.
(The speed increases smoothly as bloodlust rises.)

0.25 means 25%% faster at 100%% bloodlust. At 50%% bloodlust you'll swing 12.5%% faster.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBloodlustFrenzyMov: Max Bloodlust Frenzy Move Speed Increase

How much faster you move while in frenzy as you reach 100%% bloodlust.
(The speed increases smoothly as bloodlust rises.)

0.25 means 25%% faster at 100%% bloodlust. At 50%% bloodlust you'll be 12.5%% faster.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForExertionB:
Minimum bloodlust to start buffering exertion at.

Note that in frenzy your exertion is always buffered.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BufferExertionAfter_t:
Once you reach this level of exertion, start storing it.

25 if when first exertion moodle appears.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBufferedExertion_t: How much exertion can be stored for later.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferingMult:
How much of the removed exertion is stored for later.

1.5 means you'll be later reliving 50%% more exertion than you actually stored.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferedPerMi:
How much of exertion to store every minute.

With 2 it'll take 50 minutes to store 100 exertion.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferedPer:
How much of stored exertion to unleash back every minute.

With 3 it'll take ~30 minutes to unleash back 100 exertion.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingHu:
Proportion of hunger to add based on unleashed exertion.

0.3 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 30%% hunger.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingTh:
Proportion of thirst to add based on unleashed exertion.

0.4 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 40%% thirst.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingSt:
Proportion of muscle strain to spread across your whole body based on unleashed exertion.

0.8 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 80 strain.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MinutesSinceCombatFor: How many minutes must pass since combat before exertion unbuffering can start.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForPanicImmu:
You won't panic when above this bloodlust.

You'll also recover from panic significantly faster the closer you are to immunity.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayM:
Defines how to decay bloodiness freshness.

"Total" - remove *at most* per-minute freshness across the whole body and all equipped items.
"Individual" - remove per-minute freshness from each body part and equipped item independently.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayP:
How much bloodiness freshness to remove every minute.

Bloodiness freshness is on 0 to 100 scale.
It acts more like "Fresh Bloodiness" - same as bloodiness, but decays with time.
It's tracked separately, and no actual bloodiness is removed.

With default 0.83 and "Total" decay mode, it would take ~24 hours for 100%% overall bloodiness to go stale.
In "Individual" mode same bloodiness would decay in ~2 hours.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_EarnIt_tooltip: Whether it's possible to earn the trait.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SendIntoFrenzyOnceEar: Whether to max out bloodlust and frenzy the moment you earn the trait.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForBloodyKi: Minimum overall bloodiness for a kill to be scored as bloody.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsToEarn_too: How many bloody kills it takes to earn the trait.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayBelow: Bloody kills will decay every hour at this bloodiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayPerHo: How many bloody kills are removed every hour if you're not bloody.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayInSle: Whether to decay bloody kills while you're sleeping.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_RearDangerIfNotSeenMi: Rear Danger If Not Seen Minutes
Consider zombie behind you as rear danger if you haven't seen it for this minutes.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_RearDangerIfWithinTil: Consider zombie behind you as rear danger if it's closer than this many tiles to you.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_RearDangerMaxTiles_to: Don't consider zombies behind you as rear danger if they're further than this many tiles.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_PreFrenzyPhraseCooldo: How many in-game minutes must pass before the character will say something when frenzy begins again.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilZombieForIn: Tiles Until Zombie For In Combat
Tiles until closest zombie that is hidden behind something for player to be considered "in combat".
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilSeenZombieF: Tiles Until Seen Zombie For In Combat
Tiles until closest zombie the player can see to be considered "in combat".
Sandbox_BloodlustO_IgnoreZombiesWithFloo: Zombies below/above this many floors to you are ignored in all features relying on distance.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesScanEveryTicks: Ticks between scanning closest zombies. Don't change if you don't know what you're doing.
